# Abra Intelligence

> Abra Intelligence combines smart glasses with AI to support people in production: spot assembly errors, detect misplaced items and document every step, hands-free. The smart glasses see what the worker sees; AI compares each step against the target process in real time; workers get clear feedback on the spot and every step is documented automatically.

## Use cases

- Process monitoring: see whether SOPs are followed step by step and spot deviations as they happen
- Guided troubleshooting: context-based SOP guidance helps workers resolve disruptions faster
- Line clearance: detect remaining items and avoid contamination before the line restarts
- SOP generation: turn recordings of the real work into SOP drafts
- Worker safety: an alert before a safety-critical mistake happens, not after
- Production rounds: checkpoints are captured automatically, documentation happens on the go
